Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 성공한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 소재 찾기에 동행하길 강요한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> forced me to join her on a search of inspiration.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を成功させた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、素材探しに同行するよう強要する。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 成功完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>强迫我一起去寻找素材。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 成功完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>強迫我一起去尋找素材。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, après avoir réussi la mission, me force à l'accompagner à la recherche de sujets d'inspiration.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: „Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss der Mission zwingt <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mich, sie bei der Suche nach Inspiration zu begleiten.“
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, tras completar la misión, me obliga a acompañarla en la búsqueda de inspiración.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após concluir a missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> me forçou a acompanhá-la em sua busca por inspiração.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: ผู้ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> บังคับให้ฉันร่วมเดินทางค้นหาสิ่งที่ต้องการ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memaksa saya untuk menemaninya mencari inspirasi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã ép buộc tôi đi cùng cô ấy để tìm kiếm chất liệu sáng tác.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: एक सफल कार्य के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने मुझे प्रेरणा की तलाश में उसके साथ जाने के लिए मजबूर किया।
